_derivation: bpp = kbps*1000/(fps*pixels). Floor rung 0 (2829 kbps) -> 0.0307 bpp; top rung 2 (10303 kbps) -> 0.112 bpp. THE ONE CELL THAT DOES NOT CLEAR THE 0.04 FLOOR: the operator ruled 1280x720 the minimum encode size across every mode table (2026-08-16), and the bpp ceiling here is 707k pixels. The floor rung is therefore traded away deliberately — a soft MCS0 picture is preferred to a sub-720p one. 1024x576 was the pre-ruling pick (raw bpp wanted 960x540, which venc rejects on height % 8). Rung bitrates are §9.5 derived from the Pass 122 table (table_version 0x80).
_apply: venc fields go to waybeam_venc (sensor.mode and video0.size are restart_required, so this is a pre-flight choice); link fields are merged into /etc/waybeam-link/craft.json. Restart venc (S95waybeam) then the link (S96waybeam-link), then re-scout + quickconnect — a craft restart leaves CSA silently dead otherwise (B9).
